findings.title: The frozen outer-bound rule (stop_rules[8]) cannot be carried out on this host
detail: No terminal: each tool command runs as its own session and process-group leader without a controlling terminal, so there is no foreground group and no Ctrl-C.

Foreground mode: the Director is blocked and can send nothing at 120, 300 or 600 s; the tool's own timeout (at most 600 s) ends the command by an unchosen means; for C17 (600 s) it falls at the bound itself, so 'nothing else ends it earlier' cannot be guaranteed; a SIGKILL of the group would kill the wrapper before .exit.txt and .command.json and skip the supervisor's cleanup, while Node, in its own session, survives.

Background mode: the only group to signal is the command's own (the PID of the tool's shell, kept by the wrapper through exec); no frozen record or tool establishes its identity: the wrapper names no PID before it ends, every argv[0] in that group is a launcher whose image differs (/bin/sh, /usr/bin/env, the venv's python whose image is the framework's Python.app binary), which FC-P3 says never establishes identity, and a ps listing is context only (FC-P1); a SIGINT there breaks FC-P6 and FAILURE-CAPTURE section 6 step 1.

A single SIGINT does not reliably stop C17: supervisor_darwin_v01.run_process turns KeyboardInterrupt into Stop (lines 197-206), the provider's guarded_run_process turns any BaseException into CurrentHostBindingError (lines 1116-1140), check_case re-raises it as a test error, and unittest runs the next CPU method, which starts Node; the collector then reports COMPLETED_WITH_OTHER_OUTCOMES (exit 1), not an interruption. The runner detects it through the Stop's reason prefix (TR-18).
findings.required_change: Freeze the launch: background mode, no tool timeout, only the shell member with only its named placeholders replaced. Replace stop_rules[8]: at outer_bound_s record the overrun (UNKNOWN); start one capture_probe.py probe on every start pair recorded so far (runner intent/started-<n>, provider preflight/started); run capture_probe.py stop (FC-P6) only for a target 'present, identity established'; send nothing to the wrapper or the tool; wait for the wrapper's exit, then FAILURE-CAPTURE section 6 steps 5 to 7; if it never exits, the attempt stays UNKNOWN and the owner is told. State for C17 that an FC-P6 stop of one case may be followed by the remaining CPU starts. Interrupting the tool itself needs a reviewed means of establishing its group's identity, not available at C.

findings.title: No frozen step evaluates the predicates of the .L and .P commands
detail: Each .X runs 'w2f_s7_check.py expect --command Cnn', which evaluates only commands[Cnn].expect (checker lines 341-350); phase prepared evaluates P01 to D01 and phase post Q01 to Q03 only.

The predicates of the 19 .L commands (exit 0, /command, boots, /process_events empty, the tool's digest) and of the 3 .P commands (/targets length, every state absent) are evaluated by no frozen step; capture_probe.py exits 0 whatever the states it records.

C16.P and C17.P are FC-P3's independent check that no supervised Node group remains before the next Node-starting command (C17, C19). As frozen, a 'present' or 'unknown' target stops S7 only if the Director reads the record and applies the prose classification, so a Node start could follow an unmet expectation and the outcome is left to the Director's decision.
findings.required_change: Append each .L's and .P's predicates to the main command's expect list (its .X already runs after the .L and .P), or freeze checker steps 'expect --command Cnn.L' and 'Cnn.P' in the order.

detail: C19: MC30-probe refusing after the environment check with a message other than 'Actual input identity differs': PLAN unless an input changed; MC36 NOT_RUN.
C17: a positive case refusing at another bootstrap check (labels, manifest bindings): IMPLEMENTATION; a setUpClass EVIDENCE refusal (for example an existing override path): PLAN.
C02: state_equals_host false after P02 to P04 passed in the same boot: IMPLEMENTATION (the provider's host_state against the observer), not only HOST.
C03 to C05: a SOURCE or PYTHON refusal after P02 to P04 passed the same plans statically points to the harness (PLAN) or the observer (IMPLEMENTATION), not an input change.
